plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-10-02 from the official Case Western Reserve University General Bulletin (2026-27) 'Computer Engineering' BSE 'Sample Plan of Study' grid (https://bulletin.case.edu/engineering/ecse/computer-engineering-bse/). Footnotes: 'a': Unified General Education Requirement. 'b': Technical electives are more generally defined as any course related to the principles and practice of computer engineering. This includes all ECSE courses at the 200 level and above, and can include courses from other programs. All non-ECSE technical electives must be approved by the student's advisor. 'c': Chosen from: STAT 312, STAT 313, STAT 332, STAT 333. CREDIT RANGES: Year 2 Spring: 'FOOTNOTE-B-1' printed 3-4; modeled at 3 per official term total 16. Year 3 Fall: 'FOOTNOTE-B-2' printed 6-8; modeled at 6 per official term total 15. Year 4 Fall: 'FOOTNOTE-B-3' printed 3-4; modeled at 3 per official term total 16. Year 4 Spring: 'FOOTNOTE-B-4' printed 3-4; modeled at 3 per official term total 14. 'or' rows are modeled per convention with choice:true, first option as code, and all options in options[]. Rows combining lecture+lab (e.g. 'EBME 306 & EBME 356') are kept as one combined course with the official combined credit total. Unlabeled credit slots are elective choice placeholders. Prerequisites are not printed in the sample plan, so prereq arrays are empty; prerequisites live in the bulletin's course descriptions.
